image_bin.description: Path to the raw CD image (.bin file). Required.

image_cue.description: Path to the TOC/track index file (.cue file). Required.

output_format.description: Target output format: 'auto', 'iso', 'cdr', or 'wav'. When 'auto', inferred from input format.

psx_mode.description: Enable PlayStation mode: truncate MODE2/2352 tracks to 2336 bytes at offset 0 (instead of 2048 at offset 24).

raw_output.description: Output MODE2/2352 tracks in raw format (2352 bytes from offset 0), suitable for MPEG/VCD.

swap_audio_bytes.description: Swap byte order (endianness) of audio samples (for audio tracks only).

wavedata.description: Write audio tracks in WAV format (instead of .cdr).
